scope: Current public release, including this inventory, the SHA-256 manifest, and .gitignore; removed archives and local runtime caches are excluded.
file_size_and_hash_policy: This inventory lists paths without byte counts or hashes to avoid self-reference. MANIFEST_SHA256.json supplies bytes and SHA-256 for every listed file except itself, including this inventory.
